bioconda.name: snpick
bioconda.summary: A fast and memory-efficient tool for SNP extraction from genomic alignments.
bioconda.description: snpick is a Rust-based tool designed for extracting SNPs efficiently from large genomic alignments, with minimal RAM usage and high performance. It outputs variable sites in alignment files and provides VCF generation.

build.script:
set -xe
export LANG=C.UTF-8
export LC_ALL=C.UTF-8
export RUST_BACKTRACE=1
export OPENSSL_NO_VENDOR=1
export OPENSSL_DIR=$PREFIX
export OPENSSL_INCLUDE_DIR=$PREFIX/include
export OPENSSL_LIB_DIR=$PREFIX/lib
export LIBCLANG_PATH=$PREFIX/lib
export CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH=$PREFIX/include
cargo install --locked --verbose --root "${PREFIX}" --path .
